query_reformulation: consequence-framing + shorter text to reduce GPT reasoning time

gpt_result.consequence_if_missing: The complaint is procedurally defective as filed; the tenant may raise the omission as a procedural defense, typically supporting dismissal without prejudice or adjournment/amendment, especially if the notice was a required prerequisite.
gpt_result.note: Rule 6:3-4 is the landlord-tenant summary dispossess court rule; required notices must be attached when the landlord relies on them or they are a prerequisite to filing. If no notice is legally required for the cause of action, there is no notice to attach.

gemini_result.consequence_if_missing: Grounds for dismissal of the complaint for failure to state a claim upon which relief can be granted.
gemini_result.note: While this rule specifically mandates attaching the notice, the official complaint forms themselves (e.g., Appendix XI-X) require details from the lease, and attaching the lease is a standard and expected practice.

note: Both models agree: N.J. Ct. R. 6:3-4(c). More specific than current 'NJSA 2A:18-51 et seq. (pleading requirements)'.
